title: Pin replay of a retired placement admission key after re-enrollment
outcome: A regression preserves historical admission-key replay without silently re-admitting or authorizing the retired placement.
acceptance: A disposable fixture replays the original admission key after re-enrollment, pins the retained historical response and unchanged record, and proves current authority/binding/execution fences still reject it.
A current fresh placement remains distinct and capacity constraints remain enforced; the focused regression passes as host-recorded verification.
